note: Narrow CME/outflow to the E seen in SOHO LASCO C2. The CME is not seen in STEREO A COR2 imagery. This CME/outflow is following the 2026-10-17T17:00Z CME. No clear source was found in EUV imagery.

cmeAnalyses.note: The CME is not seen in STEREO A COR2 coronagraph and its source has not been found (possibly far-sided), so only plane-of-sky analysis is possible.

note: Faint CME first seen to the NW by GOES CCOR-1 beginning at 2026-10-18T21:30Z. This CME is not visible in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 or STEREO A COR2 in real time due to data gaps beginning at 2026-10-18T19:12Z and 2026-10-18T20:38Z respectively. The source of this event is a small region of dimming and field line opening seen in the vicinity of N10W30, extending Northward, in SDO AIA 193 beginning at approx. 2026-10-18T19:00Z.

cmeAnalyses.note: Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in GOES CCOR-1.

note: CME first seen to the West by GOES CCOR-1 beginning at 2026-10-18T23:15Z. This CME is not visible in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 or STEREO A COR2 in real time due to data gaps beginning at 2026-10-18T19:12Z and 2026-10-18T20:38Z respectively. The source of this event is field line opening seen on/beyond the West limb in GOES SUVI 284 beginning at approx. 2026-10-18T19:30Z.

cmeAnalyses.note: Plane-of-sky measurement using a longitude of W90 due to source on/beyond the Western limb and lack of STEREO A COR2 imagery to triangulate.
